bubbles.text:
I'm waiting for your report, Sergeant
Sidel.

Madam Governor, I need to hack
Earth satellites for this report.
Approved.

Why is my city still on forty
percent power?

Sorry Mayor Sonnof, the on-going
repairs for the Solar

Converters are behind schedule.
Another six months, at minimum.

Every time one fails, the hospital
emergency room fills up.
This is a crisis!

Yes, this is a very unfortunate turn
of —

You're power-cycling the Governor
of the planet?

She insisted conservation applies
to her as well.
Not my call.

This is a very unfortunate turn of
events.
Apologies to the citizens, et cetera.

Your government is working to resolve
the inconvenience, and so on.

Convey that sentiment to the citizens
of Venus City for me.
Yes, Madam Governor.
Solutions, Mayor Sonnof?

PolymerPower. It's worked as a
backup before.

Sergeant Sidel — what's the current
plastic supply?
None. Situation: desperate.

Analysis of Earthnet shows that
planet has a massive
surplus of plastic trash.

Council voted no on contacting
Earth. Request 2.13.5/A.

Because of the alien contact
concerns?
That "War of the Worlds" documentary.
Earthlings totally freaked out.

My image analysis suggests those
aliens were the Phobos-ites from
Orion.
Such a lovely species.
Great at hosting potlucks.

They just wanted to invite Earth to a
cookout!
Not a single Phobos-ite survived.

We don't need to go to war with
Earth

for their plastic waste. We can
use V.E.A.T.T. instead.

The Venus-Earth avatar-teleport
technology? Is it ready?

We can teleport any polymer
compound. Beta-testing is
complete.
Alpha begins tomorrow.
So, no, it's not ready?

Technically, "affirmatively maybe"
—

but also moving toward a not
"negative".
What does that even mean?
Don't invade. Infiltrate. I like it.

Are you still teleporting
Venusians into Earthling brains?
That's mind control!

We teleport a small polymer
implant into the brain
of an Earthling host.

An Avatar Operator neural jacks
into a Pod Controller and then --

Yes, it's mind control. I'll call it
V.E.A.T.T 2.0.

Can't we just teleport an
Earthling here, convince them
to help, send them back?

We don't have that technology. And
the Earthling host...
You can say it, Sergeant Sidel.
They achieve negative live status.
You may speak freely, Sergeant.
They die. There, I said it.

The Earthling host dies when the
jack disconnects.
That seems like a blocker to me.
It's not a blocker.

Wouldn't they notice Earthlings
dying?

The Earthlings would be very upset
at that.

They have seven billion tons of
plastic waste polluting
their oceans and cities.

That's billions with a "B." We'd be
fixing that

and saving the lives of millions of
Venusians.

It's a win-win. Why wouldn't they be
happy?

Because there'd be dead Earthling
hosts, Madam Governor.
Their families will mourn them.
There's a spiritual dimension to —

I have run a full cost-benefit
analysis of the ethics involved.

Earthlings are biodegradable. Their
plastic trash is not.
The operation is a go.
Yes, Madam Governor.

Sergeant, start the selection process
for your best operator
from the Avatar Academy.

Madam Governor, can I ask a
question?
Are we dismissed?
I guess in more ways than one.
